shared_elements: incised/relief carving on a flat rectangular stone surface
framed rectangular panel of text or scene
standing human figures in profile (in B; possibly traces in A)
justification: Both surfaces bear low-relief carving in the same script/sign tradition arranged inside a rectangular framed field, which is a real but broad correspondence. A is essentially an unbroken block of horizontal text lines with no discernible figural scene, whereas B shows a specific composition — two figures in profile flanking a central offering emblem beneath a winged/uraeus lunette — so the figural iconography and its relationships are not shared.
